detailed_descriptions_html.en:
DEFEND AGAINST HORDES OF DEMONS

Flock of the Seraphim is a horde survival roguelite bullet heaven where you defend against hordes of enemies that grow in power over time, but so do you! Gain the strength to catch up to the threat's growing power by leveling up, gathering weapon-wielding holy allies, collecting loot, and repeat. Hell has risen and its up you and heaven's cutest soldiers to repel the demonic invasion!

UNIQUE AND UPGRADEABLE GUN WIELDING ANGELS

Acquire unique angels with unique weapons and control a specialized squad of god warriors. Bows, Rifles, even RPGs? They use them! Each angel comes with a unique passive and stats that improve their fire rate, reload speed, damage, pierce, and health recovery. The currency earned fighting hordes of demons can be used to upgrade your holy power outside of the crusade and join the fight again with increased divine power!

Key Features

  • Fast runs, 10 minutes to reach the boss. Longer runs at higher difficulty

  • Over 20 different angel weapon choices to unlock with customizable designs

  • You can keep your weapons (angels) after completing the run

  • Level up, gather loot, and gain more angels mid run to get stronger

  • Collect currency for strengthening meta upgrades and angels outside of the runs
